---
title: "Municipality Reports"
page-layout: full
---

Search for a municipality below and open its report. Municipality reports summarize all commercial and industrial PINs located in that municipality, including municipalities that cross township boundaries.

Because projects may cross municipal or township boundaries, report counts are not additive across geographies.

```{r}
#| label: municipality-directory
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(DT)

slugify <- function(x) {
  x |>
    str_to_lower() |>
    str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9]+", "-") |>
    str_remove("^-") |>
    str_remove("-$")
}

comm_ind <- read_csv(
  "../Merriman RA/ptax/Output/comm_ind_PINs_2006to2024_timeseries.csv") |> select(pin, class, clean_name, Triad, Township, incent_prop, class, fmv, tif_years, years_existed, incentive_years, final_tax_to_dist, final_tax_to_tif, year) |>
  mutate(pin = as.character(pin))  |> filter(year > 2023) 

keypins <- read_xlsx(
  "Output/project_assignments_phase7_2026_09_22.xlsx"
) |>
  transmute(
    pin = as.character(pin),
    keypin = as.character(phase7_project_keypin)
  ) |>
  distinct(pin, keypin)

municipality_directory <- comm_ind |>
  filter(!is.na(clean_name), clean_name != "") |>
  left_join(keypins, by = "pin") |>
  group_by(Municipality = clean_name) |>
  summarise(
    `C&I PINs` = n_distinct(pin),
    Projects = n_distinct(keypin, na.rm = TRUE),
    Townships = n_distinct(Township, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(Municipality) |>
   mutate(
    Report = paste0(

      '<a href="municipalities/', slugify(Municipality),

      '-projects.html">Open report</a>'

    )
  )

DT::datatable(
  municipality_directory,
  rownames = FALSE,
  escape = FALSE,
  filter = "top",
  options = list(
    pageLength = 25,
    searchHighlight = TRUE,
    autoWidth = TRUE
  )
)
```
